Military drone outfit Anduril partners with Qualcomm to build laptops on US soil with new BlueChip venture
items_all.summary: The defense contractor aims to fully bring back laptop manufacturing on U.S. shores, with its first BlueChip laptop prototypes having 90% procurement cost coming from suppliers in the U.S. and other allied countries.

items_all.title: Israeli ad tech firm tied to suspected Starlink tracking effort, report claims
items_all.summary: Citizen Lab and Confiant linked Israeli firm Discover-Tech to suspected surveillance through online advertising. Researchers said its ads appeared across nearly 200,000 websites and mobile apps. TrendAI separately identified related activity under the codename “SHADOW-EARTH-79.” The findings raise concerns about ad auctions being exploited to track users across sensitive networks, though ad impressions alone do not confirm spyware infections.

TSMC reportedly weighs 20% CoWoS price increase as Nvidia Blackwell and Rubin chips put pressure on packaging capacity
items_all.summary: TSMC is reportedly weighing a price increase of up to 20% for its CoWoS advanced packaging technology as Nvidia’s Blackwell and upcoming Rubin chips intensify pressure on capacity. Equipment deliveries now reportedly take up to eight months, while separate wafer-price increases of 5% to 10% are expected in 2027, with some customers potentially facing total cost increases of up to 25%.

Samsung Portable SSD P9 review: speedy USB4 in a slim, pricey package
items_all.summary: Samsung’s Portable SSD P9 is the new USB4 external drive to beat. It feels premium and performed very well in our testing. But you’ll have to pay a lot for it, or any similarly performing drive, these days.

items_all.title: Police are reportedly pulling motorists over because AI algorithms deem their driving patterns 'suspicious'
items_all.summary: An ACLU report claims police are increasingly using AI to analyze license plate-reader data and flag motorists based on travel patterns, raising concerns that innocent drivers could be pulled over because an algorithm deemed their movements suspicious.

items_all.title: Walmart slashes $750 off this MSI RTX 5060 gaming laptop
items_all.summary: A massive $750 discount at Walmart brings the price of MSI's Crosshair gaming laptop crashing down. RTX 5060 graphics and a bright 240Hz IPS display are just two of the standout features of this laptop.

items_all.summary: The modular Keybytes project combines a Keyword hub that is magnetically connected to Keybit keys, with each key having its own microcontroller.

items_all.title: Hacker awarded $50k bounty for reporting bug to Sony that allowed PS5 Linux exploit
items_all.summary: The hypervisor bug that allowed PS5 users to install Linux on their consoles was patched before the launch of GTA VI, meaning they have to choose between experimenting with Linux and running the game.

items_all.title: Nvidia is bankrolling AI accelerator supply chain buildout to reserve production capacity
items_all.summary: Nvidia is committing billions to expand substrate, co-packaged optics, advanced packaging, and chip-testing capacity through 2028, reserving capacity at nearly every stage of its AI accelerator supply chain.

items_all.title: 60,000 Microsoft employees offered voluntary buyouts as AI buildout costs bite
items_all.summary: Microsoft is offering buyouts to around 60,000 members of its workforce as it looks to balance the books amid a ramp-up in AI data center spending.

items_all.title: Anthropic prepares for potential $2 trillion IPO valuation after reporting billions in revenue
items_all.summary: Anthropic has filed to go public as it pursues a potential multitrillion-dollar valuation, reporting $16.3 billion in revenue for the first half of 2026.
